snippet.title: DungeonBox - Beta Gameplay
snippet.description:
A quick playthrough of the early DungeonBox beta! Streamed from a single laptop over zoom to friends across the country, only one copy of the game needed
Keep in mind the game is still heavily in development, plenty of missing features and work left to do!
Kickstarter Ending August 21st: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/foxtailgames/dungeonbox?ref=user_menu
